## User-visible change

Describe the smallest behavior this pull request changes and why.

## Authority and claim boundary

State whether identity, policy, masks, capabilities, signatures, replay,
revocation, training state, runtime placement, or security claims change. Write
“none” when they do not.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. Include rejection tests for security-sensitive
changes and a clean reproduction for documentation or packaging changes.

## Release hygiene

- [ ] Tests and documentation changed together where needed.
- [ ] No credential, private data, generated package state, model weight, or
      production receipt is included.
- [ ] New third-party material has exact source, version, license, path, and
      modification notices.
- [ ] New shipped paths are classified by the applicable license map.
- [ ] The description does not broaden claims beyond the captured evidence.
